Fetch or parse a 24-hour ticker

Source: R/ticker.R
bourse_ticker.Rd

Returns a grounded market_ticker of the 24-hour rolling-window statistics for symbol, or a bourse_refusal if it will not stand behind the result. The ticker's grounding is [unverified] until bourse_catalogue_diff() has grounded the relevant facts against the exchange catalogue.

Usage

bourse_ticker(
  symbol,
  ticker = NULL,
  source = "binance",
  quote_ccy = NULL,
  base_ccy = NULL
)

Arguments

symbol

The instrument symbol, e.g. "BTCUSDT".

ticker

Optional recorded ticker payload: the named list returned by /api/v3/ticker/24hr. When supplied, no network call is made.

source

The data source; currently "binance".

quote_ccy, base_ccy

Optional quote/base currency labels for the obs_schema; these are themselves facts and stay [unverified] until grounded.

Value

A market_ticker, or a bourse_refusal.

Details

Supply ticker (the parsed /api/v3/ticker/24hr payload, a named list) to parse an offline recorded-real fixture; omit it to fetch live (requires the suggested httr2 and jsonlite packages).

See also

Other ticker: market_ticker()

Examples

# Offline: parse a small recorded-style ticker payload.
payload <- list(
  symbol = "BTCUSDT", lastPrice = "100.0", openPrice = "98.0",
  highPrice = "101.0", lowPrice = "97.0", priceChange = "2.0",
  priceChangePercent = "2.04", weightedAvgPrice = "99.0",
  volume = "1200", quoteVolume = "118800",
  openTime = 1.5e12, closeTime = 1.5e12 + 86400000)
bourse_ticker("BTCUSDT", ticker = payload)
#> <market_ticker> BTCUSDT @ binance  last=100  24h=2.04%  [grounded]
